name: What is the typical cost structure for AEO services for a CPA practice?
description: AEO service costs for CPAs vary based on scope, with monthly retainers or project fees. Factors include SEO depth, PPC budget, and content needs.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for AEO services for a CPA practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for AEO services for a CPA practice depends on the scope and complexity of the strategies implemented. Pricing models can include monthly retainers, project-based fees, or performance-based agreements. Factors influencing cost are the level of SEO, extent of PPC advertising, content creation volume, and reporting frequency. Firms can expect a range, with more comprehensive services naturally costing more, but offering potentially greater returns.
